# Rip Packs City

> Regenerated 2026-10-11 from the PUBLIC surface (proxy.ts `isPublicPath` + the sitemap set in lib/sitemap-data.ts). Every path below is readable with no account. Pinned by __tests__/llms-txt-lists-only-the-public-surface.test.ts — a gated path here reds CI.

## Overview
Rip Packs City (RPC) is independent, read-only collector intelligence for Flow blockchain digital collectibles — NBA Top Shot, NFL All Day, LaLiga Golazos, Disney Pinnacle and UFC Strike — plus Candy MLB ICONs (Solana) and Panini Blockchain cards. Fair market value (FMV) from on-chain sales, deal-finding, pack analysis, scarcity and squeeze boards, wallet tools and public entity pages. Built in Portland, Oregon.

RPC is READ-ONLY: it never connects a wallet, holds funds or executes a purchase. Listing links open the collection's own marketplace. Nothing here is investment advice.

## Public insights boards (free, no signup)
Each board is a schema.org Dataset (or WebApplication for the wallet tools); most expose their default JSON at /api/public/insights/<slug>.

- /insights — the hub: every board below in one place.
- /insights/account-value — Account Value Calculator. Paste a Top Shot username or Flow wallet and see the account's total value — live FMV across every moment it holds.
- /insights/squeeze — Top Shot Lock-Rate Squeeze Board. Ranks NBA Top Shot editions by effective supply (circulation minus locked minus burned).
- /insights/set-squeeze — Top Shot Set Squeeze Leaderboard. Sets ranked by average lock + burn squeeze across their editions.
- /insights/squeeze-check — What's Liquid In Your Bag? Paste a Flow wallet and see how much of its Top Shot collection is liquid vs challenge-locked or burned.
- /insights/market-cap — Market Cap. FMV times collector-held supply for each Flow collection and its players, teams, sets, series, tiers and badges.
- /insights/market — The RPC Index. A tier-segmented daily market index for NBA Top Shot built from real secondary-market sales.
- /insights/market-pulse — Market Pulse. Per-collection Flow secondary-market volume, sales, buyers and sellers across 24h/7d/30d.
- /insights/deals — Below FMV. Top Shot, All Day and Pinnacle editions listed below a fair value priced from recent corroborated sales, ranked by discount.
- /insights/offer-spread — Bid vs Floor. NBA Top Shot editions ranked by how tightly the top standing offer meets the floor ask.
- /insights/underpriced-serials — Underpriced #1s & Perfect Mints. Headline Top Shot serials listed below their serial-FMV estimate.
- /insights/serial-premiums — Serial Premiums — #1 Watch. How much more the #1 serial sold for than the edition's typical price.
- /insights/parallel-premiums — Parallel Premiums. The premium NBA Top Shot parallel editions command over the Standard base edition of the same play.
- /insights/trophies — The Trophy Room. The rarest Top Shot and All Day editions — every 1-of-1 and Ultimate-tier moment — ranked by FMV.
- /insights/top-sales — Top Sales — Whale Watch. The biggest recent Top Shot and All Day sales, with buyer and seller resolved to Top Shot handles.
- /insights/first-mint — Top Shot First-Mint Trophy Tracker. Every serial #1 sale of the last 90 days with its multiplier vs the average-serial price.
- /insights/rookies — 2025 NBA Rookie Class Index. Per-player 30-day GMV, lock rate and first-mint trophy presence for the 2025 rookie class.
- /insights/rookie-board — Rookie Board — 2025 Class. Every 2025 rookie edition broken out by parallel with FMV, circulation, ask, burn and lock rates.
- /insights/set-completers — Set Completers. How many collectors have completed each 2025 Top Shot rookie set, from the on-chain ownership graph.
- /insights/new-collectors — New Collectors. Who is entering NBA Top Shot — new vs returning buyers, first-buy price, gateway sets and players, cohort retention.
- /insights/cross-collection — Cross-Collection Whale Map. Flow wallets that hold 3+ collections, their cohort distribution and the Top Shot sets they collect.
- /insights/pack-reality — Top Shot Pack Reality. Every NBA Top Shot pack ripped in the last 60 days: pull-value histogram, KPIs and an honest +EV pack ranker.
- /insights/allday-pack-reality — NFL All Day Pack Reality. Each pack's odds-corrected modeled EV vs the value its opened packs actually delivered on-chain.
- /insights/topshot-pack-market — NBA Top Shot Pack Market. What sealed Top Shot packs actually resell for vs their original drop price.
- /insights/allday-pack-market — NFL All Day Pack Market. What sealed All Day packs actually resell for vs their original drop price.
- /insights/pack-sniper — Pack Sniper. Currently-listed sealed packs ranked by live secondary ask vs drop-weighted expected pull value.
- /insights/pack-drops — Pack Drops. Vaultopolis re-pack drops of real Top Shot moments scored against RPC FMV.
- /insights/pinnacle-scarcity — Disney Pinnacle Scarcity Board. Editions ranked by how far below their variant family's average mint they sit.
- /insights/allday-scarcity — NFL All Day Scarcity Board. Editions ranked by how far below their set and tier family's average mint they sit.
- /insights/tc-report — Top Collector Report. Full bag analytics for any Flow wallet — squeeze exposure, set completion, cross-collection footprint, rookie + WNBA coverage.
- /insights/candy-mlb — Candy MLB ICONs. 2026 MLB Base Series ICONs (Candy Digital / Solana): secondary FMV, best offers, bid-ask spread, pack EV, holder concentration.
- /insights/panini-squeeze — Panini WC Prizm Squeeze. Which 2026 Panini Prizm World Cup cards are still sealed — remaining supply, rip %, FMV and sealed-dollar exposure.
- /insights/panini-premiums — Panini Premiums. What numbered Panini parallels command over the common base, and what #1 / perfect-mint serials sold for.

## Cross-collection hubs
- /sniper — every collection's live listings below FMV, in one feed.
- /market — cross-collection market hub: edition lookup and leaderboards.
- /teams — franchise directory by league; /teams/<league>/<slug> is one team across every collection that carries it.

## Collections
Every collection has a public overview; the feature tabs listed are the public ones for that collection.

### NBA Top Shot
- Contract: 0x0b2a3299cc857e29 (TopShot)
- /nba-top-shot/overview — FMV, floor prices, top sales and the daily market pulse
- /nba-top-shot/market — edition-level market intelligence and leaderboards
- /nba-top-shot/sets — set completion and the cheapest path to finishing a set
- /nba-top-shot/packs — pack EV calculator and drop analysis
- /nba-top-shot/sniper — live listings below FMV

### NFL All Day
- Contract: 0xe4cf4bdc1751c65d (AllDay)
- /nfl-all-day/overview, /nfl-all-day/market, /nfl-all-day/sets, /nfl-all-day/packs, /nfl-all-day/sniper

### Disney Pinnacle
- Pins by character, franchise and variant; marketplace is disneypinnacle.com
- /disney-pinnacle/overview, /disney-pinnacle/market, /disney-pinnacle/sets, /disney-pinnacle/packs, /disney-pinnacle/sniper
- /pinnacle/moment/<id> — one pin (a `pinnacle_catalog` render)

### LaLiga Golazos
- Contract: 0x87ca73a41bb50ad5 (Golazos)
- /laliga-golazos/overview, /laliga-golazos/market, /laliga-golazos/sets, /laliga-golazos/packs, /laliga-golazos/sniper

### UFC Strike
- Contract: 0x329feb3ab062d289 (UFC_NFT). UFC Strike migrated to Aptos in July 2025; RPC covers the historical Flow market.
- /ufc/overview, /ufc/sets

### Candy MLB ICONs (Solana — chain two)
- /candy-mlb/overview, plus /insights/candy-mlb above. Solana addresses are base58 and case-sensitive.

### Panini Blockchain
- /panini-blockchain/overview, plus /insights/panini-squeeze and /insights/panini-premiums above.

## Entity pages (public, indexed, one per real-world thing)
For <collection> in nba-top-shot, nfl-all-day, laliga-golazos, ufc, candy-mlb, panini-blockchain (and disney-pinnacle for set/series/pack):
- /<collection>/edition/<slug> — one edition: FMV with confidence, floor, recent sales, serial premiums, badges
- /<collection>/player/<slug> — one player across their editions
- /<collection>/team/<slug> — one team's editions
- /<collection>/set/<slug> — one set, its editions and completion data
- /<collection>/series/<slug> — one series
- /<collection>/pack/dist/<distId> — one pack distribution and its lifecycle
- /moment/<id> — a single moment resolved by flow id, moment uuid or edition uuid
- /pinnacle/moment/<id> — a single Disney Pinnacle pin

## Collector pages
- /profile/<username> — public collector profile: trophy case, bio, saved-wallet summaries
- /share/<wallet> — a wallet's collection card: total FMV, moment count, badges

## Reading
- /blog — Field Notes: long-form analysis (RSS at /feed.xml)
- /blog/permanent-moments-ipfs — what Top Shot's IPFS pinning actually guarantees
- /blog/pinnacle-star-wars-day-2026 — what moved on Disney Pinnacle for Star Wars Day 2026
- /legal/fmv-methodology — how FMV is computed and what each confidence tier means
- /about — who builds this and why
- /privacy, /terms

## FMV, briefly
FMV is a weighted average of recent on-chain sales with recency decay and outlier filtering. Confidence tiers: HIGH (multiple recent sales), MEDIUM (sparse data), LOW (single sale or stale). Serial premiums apply to #1, jersey-match and perfect-mint serials. Full method: /legal/fmv-methodology. Every price on an edition page carries its confidence and the age of the sales behind it.

## Quick answers
- "What is my Top Shot / All Day / Pinnacle collection worth?" — /insights/account-value, or paste a wallet on the home page for a /share/<wallet> card. No account needed.
- "Is this moment underpriced?" — /insights/deals and each collection's /sniper tab list live listings priced below FMV.
- "Which packs are +EV?" — /insights/pack-sniper (sealed packs vs expected pull value) and /insights/pack-reality (what packs actually delivered).
- "Can I buy through RPC?" — No. RPC is read-only intelligence; purchases happen on the marketplace a listing links to.

## Public JSON
- /api/public/insights/<slug> — the default view of most boards above (JSON; `meta.returned_rows` and `meta.truncated` tell you whether a page is a floor)
- /api/fmv/demo — a documented FMV sample
- /sitemap.xml — the complete public URL set (five segments)
